description: Develops operads through arities, rooted-tree substitution, and associative composition with units. Endomorphism, associative, commutative, and colored operads distinguish operations from their interpretations and symmetry from commutativity; little-disk operads illustrate how geometry organizes coherent families of multiplication laws.
